rigidAxioms: Single-source CLI parity: PowerShell & GNU semantics strictly aligned; zero local wrappers masking exit codes.
Cross-platform process isolation: Zero reliance on platform-specific env vars or uninitialized state in subprocesses.
Streamlined fail-fast: Gate pipelines must fail fast on Critical violations without masking errors.
Destructive ops safety: Recursive deletions require validated prefix assertions; never erase root or parent paths (GUARD-DESTR-001).
